title: REPAIR: Resolving Long-Tail Confusion in Scientific Retrievers via Fact-Verified Iterative Refinement
abstract: arXiv:2609.18262v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Precise retrieval of scientific information is fundamentally constrained by long-tailed concepts and high fact-sensitivity of scientific corpora. These challenges often limit the effectiveness of dense retrievers and hallucination-prone LLM augmentation. To address this, we present REPAIR, a self-evolving data augmentation framework for scientific dense retrievers. REPAIR iteratively synthesizes training data to address knowledge gaps by cycling through diagnosis of long-tail concepts, API-guided evidence expansion, and differentiation via hard negative mining. This process effectively grounds retrieval in factual reality to resolve fine-grained distinctions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that REPAIR significantly outperforms 19 strong baselines on nine materials science and biomedical benchmarks. Our work highlights that diagnosing and factually augmenting data to long-tail deficits is essential for robust scientific retrieval.

translated_title: REPAIR：通过事实验证的迭代细化解决科学检索器中的长尾混淆问题
translated_abstract: 科学信息的精确检索从根本上受到长尾概念和科学语料库高事实敏感性的制约。这些挑战常常限制了稠密检索器的有效性以及易产生幻觉的大语言模型增强的效果。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了REPAIR，一个面向科学稠密检索器的自演化数据增强框架。REPAIR通过循环进行长尾概念诊断、API引导的证据扩展以及基于难负样本挖掘的区分，迭代地合成训练数据以弥补知识缺口。这一过程有效地将检索锚定在事实现实中，以解决细粒度的区分问题。大量实验表明，REPAIR在九个材料科学和生物医学基准上显著优于19个强大的基线方法。我们的工作强调，通过诊断和事实增强数据来弥补长尾缺陷对于鲁棒的科学检索至关重要。
tldr: REPAIR提出了一个自演化数据增强框架，通过长尾概念诊断、API引导的事实证据扩展和难负样本挖掘的迭代循环，为科学稠密检索器合成事实校准的训练数据，从而在九个科学基准上显著超越19个基线方法。
en_tdlr: REPAIR is a self-evolving data augmentation framework that iteratively synthesizes fact-grounded training data for scientific dense retrievers via long-tail concept diagnosis, API-guided evidence expansion, and hard negative mining, significantly outperforming 19 baselines on nine scientific benchmarks.
